{{Top|leg}}
In [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]], [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Zsinj]] created an '''impostor 181st Imperial Fighter Group'''. Led by [[Actor/Legends|actor]] [[Tetran Cowall]], posing as the vanished [[Baron of the Empire/Legends|Baron]] [[Soontir Fel/Legends|Soontir Fel]], former [[Commander/Legends|commander]] of the genuine [[181st Imperial Fighter Wing/Legends|181st Imperial Fighter Group]], the impostor 181st was composed half of organic [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] and half of [[Droid/Legends|droid]]-piloted [[Wingmate/Legends|wingman]] fighters accompanying the organic pilots. The droid fighters were packed with explosives, and it was Zsinj's plan to lure [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] commander [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] of [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]], known to be seeking out Fel, into investigating the unit and then destroy Rogue Squadron with the flying bombs. Antilles and the Rogues ultimately foiled the scheme.<ref name="Solo Command">''[[X-Wing: Solo Command]]''</ref>
